description: iPadOS Mol* Molecule Viewer - native SwiftUI iPad app with a full-screen Mol* 3D molecule viewport, local structure loading, PDB ID loading, touch gestures, representation controls, and selection details for structural biology and chemistry researchers.

userStories.title: Scaffold buildable iPadOS SwiftUI project
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a buildable native iPadOS SwiftUI project so that the molecule viewer can be implemented in a real app shell.
acceptanceCriteria: Create an iPadOS SwiftUI app project named MolApp
App launches into a root MoleculeViewerView
Project includes the minimum files needed to build from the command line or Xcode
Document the exact build command in the repository
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add full-screen molecule viewer layout
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the molecule viewer to use the full iPad screen so that the structure remains the primary workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: MoleculeViewerView contains a full-screen viewport area that fills available space
The viewport remains behind overlay controls instead of being constrained by a fixed sidebar
Layout supports portrait and landscape iPad orientations
No fixed desktop-style sidebar is introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Embed WKWebView for Mol* rendering
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a WKWebView-based viewer container so that Mol* can render molecular structures inside the native app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a SwiftUI-compatible WKWebView wrapper for the molecule viewport
WKWebView loads a bundled local HTML viewer file
The loaded HTML viewer renders a visible placeholder or empty Mol* host element
WKWebView uses settings compatible with local bundled web assets
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Bundle and initialize Mol* viewer assets
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Mol* bundled with the app so that the core 3D viewer does not depend on loading the viewer library from the network.
acceptanceCriteria: Mol* viewer assets are included as local app bundle resources
The local viewer HTML initializes a Mol* plugin instance
The Mol* canvas fills the WKWebView viewport
Initialization errors are surfaced to the native app or visible debug state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Create Swift to JavaScript bridge commands
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a small Swift-to-JavaScript bridge so that native controls can drive the Mol* viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Bridge exposes loadLocalStructure, loadPdbId, setRepresentation, toggleVisibility, focusSelection, setSelection, and clearSelection commands
Bridge command payloads are encoded as JSON instead of string-concatenated JavaScript values
JavaScript side handles unknown commands with a non-crashing error response
Swift side can receive command success or failure messages from WKWebView
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Load local PDB and mmCIF files
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to open local molecular structure files from the iPad Files app so that I can inspect my own data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a file picker entry point in the viewer UI
File picker accepts pdb, cif, and mmcif files
Selected file content is sent to Mol* through loadLocalStructure
A valid local structure renders in the 3D viewport
Failed file reads or parse errors show a clear non-blocking error state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Load structures by PDB ID
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to load a public structure by PDB ID so that I can inspect known structures without manually downloading files.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a PDB ID input flow in the viewer UI
Submitting a valid PDB ID calls loadPdbId
loadPdbId requests an RCSB-compatible structure download URL
Loaded PDB ID structure renders in the same Mol* viewport as local files
Invalid IDs or network failures show a clear non-blocking error state
Local file loading remains available and unchanged
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Support iPad touch camera gestures
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to rotate, pan, zoom, and focus the molecule with standard iPad gestures so that navigation feels natural without a mouse.
acceptanceCriteria: One-finger drag rotates the molecule
Two-finger drag pans the view
Pinch gesture zooms in and out
Double tap calls focusSelection when an atom or residue is selected
Double tap does not trigger file loading, panel state changes, or toolbar actions
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using available Codex browser tooling, MCP browser tooling, or Playwright

userStories.title: Add floating representation toolbar
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want one-tap representation controls so that I can switch between common molecular views while keeping the structure visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a floating edge-aligned toolbar over the viewport
Toolbar includes Ribbon, Surface, and Stick representation actions
Toolbar can be collapsed or kept compact so it does not permanently consume viewport width
Tapping each representation action calls setRepresentation without reloading the structure
Toolbar controls remain usable in portrait and landscape orientations

userStories.title: Add structural visibility toggles
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want quick toggles for water, ligands, and disulfide bonds so that I can reduce visual clutter during inspection.
acceptanceCriteria: Floating toolbar includes Water, Ligand, and Disulfide toggles
Each toggle calls toggleVisibility with the matching feature key
Toggling a feature updates the current Mol* view without a full structure reload

acceptanceCriteria: Add a bottom sheet overlay with collapsed and expanded states

userStories.title: Highlight selected structure and dim context
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the selected atom or residue highlighted and surrounding structure dimmed so that the selected region is easy to find in complex molecules.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected atom or residue is visually highlighted in the Mol* viewport

clearSelection removes highlight and restores normal structure visibility
